setup: Step up on a box under the bar
execution: Lift your feet and hang, arms straight
Let your body settle; no swinging
Step back onto the box to finish
faults: Don't swing or kick your legs
Don't drop off when your grip goes

notes: Keep a box or bench under the bar so you can step down instead of dropping.
Start with short holds, or keep your toes on the box to take some weight, and build up.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
